name: sidebar
useFor: Use for an app's main navigation. Wrap the app in SidebarProvider; put the lockup in SidebarHeader, groups of SidebarMenuButton rows (isActive on the current page, a filled Phosphor glyph first) in SidebarContent, and Help, the organization (SidebarMenuBadge with ADMIN) and the account in SidebarFooter; the page goes in SidebarInset. Use variant secondary for a second rail beside it (an agent's workspace), collapsible icon to let it narrow to its glyphs (rows then show their tooltip), and SidebarTrigger or Cmd B to toggle. On phones it opens in a sheet.
constraints: A purple pill for the current row
Animating the rail when the keyboard shortcut toggles it
source: Figma 427:2715: the rail in Dashboard - empty state and every console screen; the second rail in Agent Workspace - Inbox
